links.outcome: Acceptance of incorrect versus correct AI recommendations by clinicians in vignettes (overreliance)
links.effect: Participants accepted 374 of 748 (50%) incorrect recommendations and rejected 112 of 680 (16.47%) correct recommendations; trust was lower for incorrect advice (β=-0.772).
links.quote: Participants accepted 374 of 748 (50%) incorrect recommendations and rejected 112 of 680 (16.47%) correct recommendations.

screen.reason: This experimental pilot study evaluated clinicians' (nurses and physicians) trust and acceptance/rejection behavior in response to correct vs. intentionally incorrect AI-based clinical decision support recommendations across simulated clinical vignettes, but did not test a specific deployment safeguard or intervention.
